citizen_relevance: Primary mechanism for obtaining OPD report logs, CMIA disclosure logs, pension Trust authorization records, and financial transaction histories without party cooperation. SDTs to medical providers for CMIA disclosure logs will reveal all third-party records accesses including any §56.10(c)(12) probate court investigator disclosures. SDTs to pension Trust will compel retirement election application and authorization records.
